test.result: 65 passed in the focused execution stress, evidence gate and report suites; Ruff and mypy passed.

implemented: A deterministic report builds the full 1.0x/1.5x/2.0x cost by 100%/75%/50% fill-rate grid from every frozen intention.
Missed and partial opportunities must remain in the input population; duplicate IDs and missing gross/cost inputs are rejected.
The report exposes scenario net P&L and NAV return, a content hash of the frozen intention population, and the existing robust-economics gate.
Output is explicitly labelled SCENARIO_STRESS with a uniform fill-scaling assumption; it cannot be presented as observed execution.
blockers: Observed forward fill outcomes are unavailable, so scenario scaling is not yet calibrated to actual fills.
